subject: Mathematics
topic: Relations and their types: empty and universal
title: Empty and Universal Relations
summary: In a boys' school, who is whose sister? Nobody, and Maths has a name for that. What a relation is, and its two extreme cases.
keyPoints: A **relation** R in a set A is a subset of **A × A**.
**Empty relation:** no element is related to any element, so R is the empty set.
**Universal relation:** every element is related to every element, so R = A × A.
Every other relation lies between the two.
